title: Mathematics: Textbook for Class XI — Grade 11 Mathematics (CBSE / NCERT)

source.title: Mathematics: Textbook for Class XI
source.edition: First edition February 2006; revised (rationalised) edition November 2022; reprinted March 2024, June 2024, January 2025 and February 2026 (printing marked 'Reprint 2026-27'); ISBN 81-7450-486-9
source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/cbse-g11.json. Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/CurriculumMain27/SecPart2/Maths_SecP2_2026-27.pdf https://cbseacademic.nic.in/curriculum_2027.html https://www.cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/CurriculumMain26/SrSec/Maths_SrSec_2025-26.pdf https://ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/kemh1ps.pdf. Notes: Textbook status: the NCERT Class XI prelims PDF on ncert.nic.in carries the line 'Reprint 2026-27' (February 2026) of the November 2022 rationalised edition. Two secondary news reports (March 2026) of an NCERT notice say new NCF-SE-based books for Classes 10 and 11 are deferred to 2027-28. I could not open the NCERT notice itself; treat the deferral as reported, not verified. In 2027-28 this file will need replacing. Curriculum: CBSE moved Classes XI-XII to a 'Secondary Part 2' curriculum for 2026-27 (file Maths_SecP2_2026-27.pdf). Its Class XI content, unit marks and formative-only list read the same as the 2025-26 Senior Secondary document. Formative-only topics (not in summative assessment) per CBSE 2026-27: practical problems on union/intersection of two sets; composition of functions; general solutions of sin y = sin a, cos y = cos a, tan y = tan a; principle of mathematical induction; polar representation of complex numbers, statement of the Fundamental Theorem of Algebra and solving quadratics with real coefficients in the complex number system; graphical solution of linear inequalities in two variables and of systems of them; general and middle terms of a binomial expansion; sums of k, k^2, k^3; normal form and general equation of a line; section formula in 3D; derivative of composite functions (chain rule); random experiments, outcomes and sample spaces. Outcomes for these are included with difficulty 'exte
